args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (Juniper Blog + Companion)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel price movements.
- Shippers who diversified volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs (per companion piece analysis).
- Taken together: the market favors diversified carrier strategies and contract stability as a hedge against spot-rate volatility and fluctuating fuel costs.
